title: Hanuma's advise to Sugreeva
introduction: Sugreeva is disturbed at the unfounded anger of Lakshmana and wanted his ministers to elicit the cause for that anger. Hanuma informs Sugreeva that causing delay is the only fault of Sugreeva, for which Sugreeva is advised to pray for the mercy of Lakshmana personally.
closing: इति वाल्मीकि रामायणे आदि काव्ये किष्किन्ध काण्डे द्वा त्रिंशः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 32nd chapter in Kishkindha Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
अंगदस्य वचः श्रुत्वा सुग्रीवः सचिवैः सह |
लक्ष्मणम् कुपितम् श्रुत्वा मुमोच आसनम् आत्मवान्
verses.iast:
aṃgadasya vacaḥ śrutvā sugrīvaḥ sacivaiḥ saha |
lakṣmaṇam kupitam śrutvā mumoca āsanam ātmavān
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Angada along with those of his ministers, namely Hanuma, Plaksha, and Prabhava et al, also on knowing that Lakshmana is angered, that sensible Sugreeva stirred from seat.

glosses.meaning: ministers [others like Hanuma, apart from Plaksha, Prabhava,] along with
Lakshmana, as angered one, on hearing - on knowing
seat, released - got up from seat.

verses.devanagari:
स च तान् अब्रवीत् वाक्यम् निश्चित्य गुरु लाघवम् |
मंत्रज्ञान् मंत्र कुशलो मंत्रेषु परिनिष्ठितः
verses.iast:
sa ca tān abravīt vākyam niścitya guru lāghavam |
maṃtrajñān maṃtra kuśalo maṃtreṣu pariniṣṭhitaḥ
verses.translation: On discriminating the pros and cons Sugreeva spoke this sentence to the strategist-ministers, for he himself is an expert in strategies and a diligent one in carrying out those strategies.

verses.devanagari:
न मे दुर् व्याहृतम् किंचित् न अपि मे दुर् अनुष्ठितम् |
लक्ष्मणो राघव भ्राता क्रुद्धः किम् इति चिंतये
verses.iast:
na me dur vyāhṛtam kiñcit na api me dur anuṣṭhitam |
lakṣmaṇo rāghava bhrātā kruddhaḥ kim iti ciṃtaye
verses.translation: "I have not in the least spoken any ill of them, nor committed any misdeed in their respect, thus I am thinking why should Raghava's brother Lakshmana take offence at me?

glosses.meaning: thus, it is being thought - by me.

verses.devanagari:
असुहृद्भिः मम अमित्रैः नित्यम् अन्तर दर्शिभिः |
मम दोषान् असंभूतान् श्रावितो राघवानुजः
verses.iast:
asuhṛdbhiḥ mama amitraiḥ nityam antara dar.hśibhiḥ |
mama doṣān asambhūtān śrāvito rāghavānujaḥ
verses.translation: "Unsympathetic rivals of mine, who will always be snoopy for scope, might have ear-filled Raghava's brother about the fabricated faults of mine.

glosses.meaning: un, kind, hearted ones - by unsympathetic rivals
for scope, searchers - by opportunists, fabricators

verses.devanagari:
अत्र तावत् यथा बुद्धि सर्वैः एव यथा विधि |
भावस्य निश्चयः तावत् विज्ञेयो निपुणम् शनैः
verses.iast:
atra tāvat yathā buddhi sarvaiḥ eva yathā vidhi |
bhāvasya niścayaḥ tāvat vijñeyo nipuṇam śanaiḥ
verses.translation: "In this situation, all of you on your part and according to your perspectives have to find out firstly and meticulously about the attitude of Lakshmana, along with a steady but diligent determination thereof.

glosses.meaning: attitude [of Lakshmana, or, issue of fact]

verses.devanagari:
न खलु अस्ति मम त्रासो लक्ष्मणान् न अपि राघवात् |
मित्रम् तु अस्थान कुपितम् जनयति एव संभ्रमम्
verses.iast:
na khalu asti mama trāso lakṣmaṇān na api rāghavāt |
mitram tu asthāna kupitam janayati eva sambhramam
verses.translation: "Definitely there is no fear for me from Lakshmana, not even from Raghava, but an unfounded ire of a friend alone is giving rise to disquiet.
notes: The word a + sthāna kupitam - a + sthāna kopam, is twofold in its meaning, one is 'unfounded anger' and the other is 'angered out of place, context.' Lakshmana who has so far not visited Kishkindha has darted into Kishkindha and showing his ire here, which is out of context. Lakshmana should have summoned Sugreeva or any other monkey, or he should have come as a calm and collected emissary, and then he can become ireful if Sugreeva rejects any help. But Lakshmana's entry itself is 'unfounded or unreasonable.' This one statement of Sugreeva makes him lofty of virtue in his heart of hearts for he reposed full confidence in Rama and thus fearless of a trusted friend.

glosses.meaning: not, founded - unfounded / out of context

verses.devanagari:
सर्वथा सुकरम् मित्रम् दुष्करम् प्रतिपालनम् |
अनित्यत्वात् तु चित्तानाम् प्रीतिः अल्पे अपि भिद्यते
verses.iast:
sarvathā sukaram mitram duṣkaram pratipālanam |
anityatvāt tu cittānām prītiḥ alpe api bhidyate
verses.translation: "It is always practicable to befriend any, but in turn it is impracticable to manage that friendship, even a trifle splits off that friendliness for sentiments are transient.

glosses.meaning: easy, to make - easy to befriended
not, permanent [impermanency, transient nature,] owing to

verses.devanagari:
अतो निमित्तम् त्रस्तो अहम् रामेण तु महात्मना |
यन् मम उपकृतम् शक्यम् प्रतिकर्तुम् न तन् मया
verses.iast:
ato nimittam trasto aham rāmeṇa tu mahātmanā |
yan mama upakṛtam śakyam pratikartum na tan mayā
verses.translation: "On that score I am flustering because of the noble-souled Rama, and I cannot possibly requite the favour that has been done to me." So said Sugreeva to his ministers.

glosses.meaning: on that, score, aham = I am

verses.devanagari:
सुग्रीवेण एवम् उक्ते तु हनुमान् हरि पुंगवः |
उवाच स्वेन तर्केण मध्ये वानर मंत्रिणाम्
verses.iast:
sugrīveṇa evam ukte tu hanumān hari puṅgavaḥ |
uvāca svena tarkeṇa madhye vānara maṃtriṇām
verses.translation: While Sugreeva is saying that way, the eminent-monkey Hanuma spoke with a dint of his own expediency, from among the Vanara ministers.

glosses.meaning: by Sugreeva, that way, while being said, but
with his own, by logic [with a dint of his expediency]

verses.devanagari:
सर्वथा न एतद् आश्चर्यम् यत् त्वम् हरिगणेश्वर |
न विस्मरसि सुस्निग्धम् उपकारम् कृतम् शुभम्
verses.iast:
sarvathā na etad āścaryam yat tvam harigaṇeśvara |
na vismarasi susnigdham upakāram kṛtam śubham
verses.translation: "In any case, it is not astonishing to say, oh, king of monkey troops, that you with a deep regard have not forgotten the advantageous help rendered to you, since it is natural for you.

glosses.meaning: in any way, astonishing, it is not.

verses.devanagari:
राघवेण तु वीरेण भयम् उत्सृज्य दूरतः |
त्वत् प्रिय अर्थम् हतो वाली शक्र तुल्य पराक्रमः
verses.iast:
rāghaveṇa tu vīreṇa bhayam utsṛjya dūrataḥ |
tvat priya artham hato vālī śakra tulya parākramaḥ
verses.translation: "On his part Raghava tossed off his fear distantly and eliminated Vali, whose valour equals that of Indra, only to fulfil your cherish.

glosses.meaning: by braving, Raghava, on his part

verses.devanagari:
सर्वथा प्रणयात् क्रुद्धो राघवो न अत्र संशयः |
भ्रातरम् संप्रहितवान् लक्ष्मणम् लक्ष्मि वर्धनम्
verses.iast:
sarvathā praṇayāt kruddho rāghavo na atra saṃśayaḥ |
bhrātaram samprahitavān lakṣmaṇam lakṣmi vardhanam
verses.translation: "Anywise, by virtue of his friendliness with you Raghava must be annoyed, hence he must have expedited his brother Lakshmana, whose disposition in effect to is enhance prosperity.

glosses.meaning: in that, doubt, is not there

verses.devanagari:
त्वम् प्रमत्तो न जानीषे कालम् कलविदाम् वर |
फुल्ल सप्त च्छद श्यामा प्रवृत्ता तु शरत् शिवा
verses.iast:
tvam pramatto na jānīṣe kālam kalavidām vara |
phulla sapta cchada śyāmā pravṛttā tu śarat śivā
verses.translation: "You have become ecstatic, oh, the best of the best timekeepers, hence you are unaware of the slippage of time, but the sedate and dark-green autumn on its part is underway unfolding dark-green leaves canopying seven-leaved banana plants.
notes: Sugreeva is ascribed as a great disciplinarian and punctualist and his order sugrīva ājña ' Sugreeva's order...' a Sanskrit phrase still ruling high, is an inalienable, do-or-die order for the rank and file of Vanara-s.

glosses.meaning: among time, knowers - a timekeeper, [a person as regards punctuality,] the best
you were, verily, - on the moon, ecstatic
[about the slippage of] time, not, aware
unfolded, seven-leaved, covering [canopying seven-leaved-plantain trees,] with dark-greenness

verses.devanagari:
निर्मल ग्रह नक्षत्रा द्यौः प्रनष्ट बलाहका |
प्रसन्नाः च दिशः सर्वाः सरितः च सरांसि च
verses.iast:
nirmala graha nakṣatrā dyauḥ pranaṣṭa balāhakā |
prasannāḥ ca diśaḥ sarvāḥ saritaḥ ca sarāṃsi ca
verses.translation: "Clear is the sky with its planets and stars as clouds have vanished on it, even all the ten directions are clear, and the rivers and lakes too are equable.

verses.devanagari:
प्राप्तम् उद्योग कालम् तु न अवैषि हरिपुंगव |
त्वम् प्रमत्त इति व्यक्तम् लक्ष्मणो अयम् इह आगतः
verses.iast:
prāptam udyoga kālam tu na avaiṣi haripuṃgava |
tvam pramatta iti vyak{}tam lakṣmaṇo ayam iha āgataḥ
verses.translation: "Because the time for campaigns has chanced, oh, the ablest monkey, and because you were very slumberous you have not got the drift of it, as such Lakshmana must have come here, and it is obvious.

glosses.meaning: not, you realised - not got the drift of it
this one, Lakshmana, to here, came

verses.devanagari:
आर्तस्य हृत दारस्य परुषम् पुरुष अन्तरात् |
वचनम् मर्षणीयम् ते राघवस्य महात्मनः
verses.iast:
ārtasya hṛta dārasya paruṣam puruṣa antarāt |
vacanam marṣaṇīyam te rāghavasya mahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: "Raghava's bitter words are endurable by you as he is primarily an anguished person, further he is the one whose is wife is abducted, and furthermore he is magnanimous in giving kingdom to you, besides, he is reproachful through another person, namely Lakshmana.

glosses.meaning: benevolent-souled one - magnanimous in giving kingdom

verses.devanagari:
कृत अपराधस्य हि ते न अन्यत् पश्यामि अहम् क्षमम् |
अंतरेण अंजलिम् बद्ध्वा लक्ष्मणस्य प्रसादनात्
verses.iast:
kṛta aparādhasya hi te na anyat paśyāmi aham kṣamam |
aṃtareṇa aṃjalim baddhvā lakṣmaṇasya prasādanāt
verses.translation: "Indeed, I do not foresee any other appropriate means for you, as a blunder is committed by you, other than seeking Lakshmana's pardon duly adjoining your palms.
notes: The clasping and adjoining of palms in supplication is the highest gesture to appease others and it yields beneficence of even gods quickly. an~jaliḥ paramā mudrā kśipram deva prasādinī 'Adjoining palms reverently is the highest gesture, and gods will bestow grace by it.' Here it is said in singular meaning that 'you appease Lakshmana single-mindedly... soulfully...'

verses.devanagari:
नियुक्तैः मंत्रिभिः वाच्यो अवश्यम् पार्थिवो हितम् |
इत एव भयम् त्यक्त्वा ब्रवीमि अवधृतम् वचः
verses.iast:
niyuk{}taiḥ maṃtribhiḥ vācyo avaśyam pārthivo hitam |
ita eva bhayam tyak{}tvā bravīmi avadhṛtam vacaḥ
verses.translation: "A king is to be advised beneficially and unhesitatingly by the minister designates, that is why I am speaking what I hold fast discarding fear.

glosses.meaning: without hesitation, beneficial, is to be spoken - advised
emphatic - which I hold fast, words, I am saying.

verses.devanagari:
अभिक्रुद्धः समर्थो हि चापम् उद्यम्य राघवः |
स देव असुर गंधर्वम् वशे स्थापयितुम् जगत्
verses.iast:
abhikruddhaḥ samartho hi cāpam udyamya rāghavaḥ |
sa deva asura gaṃdharvam vaśe sthāpayitum jagat
verses.translation: "If Raghava is highly infuriated he is capable to keep the world under his control along with gods, demons, gandharva-s just on hitching up his bow, isn't it!

glosses.meaning: in control, to keep, capable, isn't it.

verses.devanagari:
न स क्षमः कोपयितुम् यः प्रसाद्य पुनर् भवेत् |
पूर्व उपकारम् स्मरता कृतज्ञेन विशेषतः
verses.iast:
na sa kṣamaḥ kopayitum yaḥ prasādya punar bhavet |
pūrva upakāram smaratā kṛtajñena viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: "It becomes unseemly to infuriate him who is to be placated time and again, especially when remembering his earlier beneficence to you and when you are beholden to him.

glosses.meaning: especially, as one beholden to him
[time and ] again, who is to be placated

verses.devanagari:
तस्य मूर्ध्ना प्रणम्य त्वम् स पुत्रः स सुहृत् जनः |
राजन् तिष्ठ स्व समये भर्तुः भार्या इव तत् वशे
verses.iast:
tasya mūrdhnā praṇamya tvam sa putraḥ sa suhṛt janaḥ |
rājan tiṣṭha sva samaye bhartuḥ bhāryā iva tat vaśe
verses.translation: "Prostrate yourself before him along with your son, friends and relatives to pay deference, oh, king, and abide by your own accord you made with him remaining under his auspices, like a wife abiding in the care of her husband.

glosses.itrans: sa putraH sa su hR^it janaH
glosses.iast: sa putraḥ sa su hṛt janaḥ
glosses.devanagari: स पुत्रः स सु हृत् जनः
glosses.meaning: along with, son, with, kind, hearted, people [friends and relatives]
with forehead, pay deference - prostrate yourself
in his, control, you stay - remain under his auspices.

verses.devanagari:
न राम रामानुज शासनम् त्वया
कपीन्द्र युक्तम् मनसा अपि अपोहितुम् |
मनो हि ते ज्ञास्यति मानुषम् बलम्
स राघवस्य अस्य सुरेन्द्र वर्चसः
verses.iast:
na rāma rāmānuja śāsanam tvayā
kapīndra yuk{}tam manasā api apohitum |
mano hi te jñāsyati mānuṣam balam
sa rāghavasya asya surendra varcasaḥ
verses.translation: "It will be unseemly to fend off the ruling of Rama, or of his brother Lakshmana even in your imagination, oh, king of monkeys, as your heart is aware of the humanly tenacity of that Rama, whose resplendence vies with that of Indra, and who is associated with selfsame Lakshmana, isn't it." Thus Hanuma spoke to Sugreeva.
notes: For the usage of words mānuṣam balam it is said as 'his humanly adventures are already known to you, yet his divine expeditions are to be known by you.'

glosses.meaning: at heart, even - even in imagination
to set aside - keep it at bay, fend off
together with, the legatee of Raghu - here, Lakshmana
king of gods, Indra, having resplendence
humanly, tenacity [keeping a firm hold of principles, life]
your, heart, knows it, isn't it.
